newsitem.title: FINLAND: Amer to divest MacGregor Golf Company.
newsitem.headline: Amer to divest MacGregor Golf Company.

text.p: Finnish sporting goods group Amer-yhtyma Oy said Monday it had signed a letter of intent to sell its MacGregor Golf Company to privately owned English company Masters International Ltd.
MacGregor's golf club factory is located in Albany, Ga. It has offices in Atlanta and seven sales subsidiaries around the world, Amer said.
All MacGregor operations will be transferred to Masters International by the end of November, Amer said.
It said MacGregor employs 190 people and had net sales in 1995 of 221 million markka ($48.3 million).
"Amer will incur a one-time loss of approximately 36 million markka ($7.9 million) on the conclusion of the transaction," Amer said.
MacGregor Golf makes only golf equipment. Other sporting goods sold under the MacGregor name are made by a subsidiary of Roadmaster Industries Inc., also of Atlanta.
